requirement_override: Owner's smooth-profile correction supersedes the previous required raised-shoulder depression and lower-bumper protrusion. New convexity/crown/brow-leading bounds replace them; existing seam/depth/symmetry/normal/budget/physics tolerances remain.
initial_issues: Initial off-center sections exposed folded front strips from incompatible lid/surround transverse mapping; shared stations correct them.
Constant-across tangents left off-center kinks; fixed-X tangents correct the actual nose transition.
Individual triangle-edge angles contain sub-millimetre faceting noise; equal 20 mm mesh arcs retain the 1 degree reverse-turn bound.
The simpler model still failed at 1.208 degrees; retaining front transverse samples corrects that failure without a relaxed bound.
The exact rejected model fails twelve of the same 32 checks; its matched views and metrics remain.
The old strip-normal method on identical geometry fails both new normal-continuity checks (32/2); stable master normals correct the damaged reflections.
An initial concurrent TrackBrowser import interruption is retained; sequential normal retry passes without unrelated source changes.
limitations: Client reload and owner/device appearance, motion and rendering-cost acceptance remain.
Desktop Mobile uses PC Vulkan; manual-stepping race-hitch diagnostics are not a frame-pacing measurement.
No device attachment check or device test, APK, purchase, live mutation, deployment or owner-process restart.
Concurrent dirty work is preserved. Document snapshots at edit time isolate this task's additions.
